title: Rounding to Fourier granularity
statement: For an integer $k\ge 0$, let $g_k=2(1/2)^k$. If $q\in\mathbb Q$ and $z\in\mathbb Z$ satisfy $|q-zg_k|<g_k/2$, then rounding $q$ to the nearest multiple of $g_k$ gives $zg_k$.
